problem.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock I
problem.problemStatement: Given the daily prices of a stock, determine the maximum profit obtainable from exactly one buy and one sell transaction.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains N integers representing stock prices.
